title: German Cheesy Lasagna Casserole
description: A comforting and creamy twist on the classic lasagna, inspired by German flavors.
instructions: Cook lasagna noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking into small pieces as it cooks.
Add diced onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until softened.
Stir in German-Style Cheese Blend until melted and smooth.
In a separate pot, combine heavy cream and sour cream. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Stir in cooked lasagna noodles, German-Style Cheese Blend mixture, and cooked ground beef mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Top with additional German-Style Cheese Blend and chopped parsley (if using).
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
Let cool for 10-15 minutes before serving.
